# meeting-minutes

> Turn meeting transcripts into validated minutes with summary, decisions and action items with owner and due date through an LLM port Python package `trysac-meeting-minutes`, import name `meeting_minutes`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example

- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
